confidence_explanation: The evidence shows a clear pattern of unauthorized access and data exfiltration. The user logged in from an unusual IP address (not in baseline) and performed a high volume of file reads followed by multiple file downloads across two consecutive days, significantly exceeding their baseline of 1 download per day.

attack_chain.description: Unauthorized login from an unusual IP (45.79.97.21) outside of normal working hours.
Initial data exfiltration: successful download of a legal agreement.
Continued data collection and exfiltration: download of a configuration file.
Second day of unauthorized access from the same unusual IP.
Bulk data exfiltration: multiple large file downloads (release notes and data export) in rapid succession.
Final observed exfiltration of a legal agreement spreadsheet.

gaps: Verification of whether the IP 45.79.97.21 belongs to a known VPN or authorized remote access provider.
Information regarding whether user_08 was on approved travel or remote work status.
narrative: User_08, a corporate counsel, accessed the system from an unrecognized IP address outside of normal working hours. Over two days, the user exhibited a pattern of reading numerous legal files and performing multiple large-scale downloads, which significantly deviates from their established baseline of one download per day, indicating successful data exfiltration.
